**Finding: compliant** (rule RENEWAL, § 11.1 / p0096).

- **Renewal term:** successive one (1) year periods — no automatic multi-year renewal, so no walk-away exposure.
- **Notice window:** thirty (30) (days), exercisable by either party, so Corio can opt out at 30 days — inside the preferred ≤30-day standard.
- **Pricing:** fees for renewal periods are set by the Exhibit B tiers ("Year 2-5, and beyond"); Commerce One has no unilateral uplift right, so the absent CPI/3% cap is not a material gap.
- **Noted, not flagged:** no vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and no express uplift cap — minor sub-elements short of preferred wording only.

No redline proposed.
